@phoneProgSent.description: Payment steps, first step of a payment you sent. One word.

phoneProgNetwork: In the network, waiting for a block

@phoneProgNetwork.description: Payment steps: the payment is on the network and no block holds it yet.

@phoneProgSenderFinished.description: Payment steps of a payment you receive: the sender has completed their part.

@phoneProgPayerPending.description: Reason line under the current step of a request you sent that is not paid yet.

@phoneProgPayerPendingNamed.description: Reason line under the current step of a request you sent that is not paid yet. {name} is the payer.

phoneProgSenderPending: Waiting for the sender to finish the payment

@phoneProgSenderPending.description: Reason line: a payment is arriving and the sender has not finished it yet.

phoneProgSenderPendingNamed: Waiting for {name} to finish the payment

@phoneProgSenderPendingNamed.description: Reason line: a payment is arriving and the sender has not finished it yet. {name} is the sender.

phoneProgReported: The sender says it is on the network

@phoneProgReported.description: Reason line: the sender reports the payment posted to the network; this wallet has not seen it in a block.

phoneProgReportedNamed: {name} says it is on the network

@phoneProgReportedNamed.description: Reason line: the sender reports the payment posted to the network. {name} is the sender.

phoneProgPostElsewhere: Finished but not posted. Post it from another connection.

@phoneProgPostElsewhere.description: Reason line: the payment is complete on this phone but could not be posted to the network from here.

@phoneProgPosting.description: Reason line: the wallet is sending the finished payment to the network right now.

phoneProgKillSwitch: Held back while all connections are off

@phoneProgKillSwitch.description: Reason line: the payment is finished but the Kill switch holds every connection.

phoneProgNotPosted: Not posted yet. Post it again.

@phoneProgNotPosted.description: Reason line: the finished payment did not reach the network and can be posted again.

phoneProgNoNewBlock: No new block yet. The network is slow right now.

@phoneProgNoNewBlock.description: Reason line: the payment is on the network and the chain has found no new block for a while.

phoneProgNotInBlock: On the network, but no block has taken it yet

@phoneProgNotInBlock.description: Reason line: new blocks come, but none holds this payment yet.

phoneProgInNetwork: On the network. A block will include it soon.

@phoneProgInNetwork.description: Reason line: the payment is on the network and waits for the next block.

phoneProgAnswersEpicbox: It answers when the recipient next opens it.

@phoneProgAnswersEpicbox.description: Reason line of a sent payment that waits for the other wallet, sent through Epicbox.

phoneProgAnswersEpicboxNamed: It answers when {who} next opens it.

@phoneProgAnswersEpicboxNamed.description: Reason line of a sent payment that waits for the other wallet, sent through Epicbox. {who} is the recipient's name.

phoneProgWaitingAnswer: Waiting for their wallet to answer

@phoneProgWaitingAnswer.description: Payment steps: the second step of a payment you sent through Epicbox, the recipient's wallet has not answered yet.

@phoneProgWaitingAnswerNamed.description: Payment steps: the second step of a payment you sent through Epicbox, the recipient's wallet has not answered yet. {name} is the recipient's name.

phoneProgAnswersFile: It continues when the answer file comes back.

@phoneProgAnswersFile.description: Reason line of a sent payment that travels as a file and waits for the answer file.

phoneProgAnswersFileNamed: It continues when the answer file from {who} comes back.

@phoneProgAnswersFileNamed.description: Reason line of a sent payment that travels as a file and waits for the answer file. {who} is the recipient's name.

phoneProgAnswersLive: Their wallet has not answered yet.

@phoneProgAnswersLive.description: Reason line of a sent payment that waits for the other wallet to answer directly.

@phoneProgAnswersLiveNamed.description: Reason line of a sent payment that waits for the other wallet to answer directly. {who} is the recipient's name.

@phoneProgSetAside.description: Second sentence of a reason line: the amount a waiting send keeps reserved. {amount} is like '12.508 EPIC'.

@phoneActSearchHint.description: Search field hint on the Activity screen.

@phoneActNeedsYou.description: Group heading on Activity above invoices that wait for the user's decision.

@phoneActInProgress.description: Group heading on Activity above payments that are not finished yet.

@phoneActSealed.description: Second line of an Activity row for a payment sealed with epic1. One word.

@phoneActCancelledNothing.description: Second line of an Activity row for a payment the user cancelled before any coins moved.

@phoneActReview.description: Button on the Needs you card of Activity that opens an invoice. A verb.

@phoneActInvoiceFor.description: Second line of the Needs you card: someone asks the user to pay. {amount} is the amount with the unit.

@phoneActEmptyTitle.description: Title of the Activity screen when the wallet has no payments.

@phoneActNoneTitle.description: Title of the Activity screen when a filter or a search finds no payment.

@phoneActMenu.description: Tooltip of the three-dot button in the Activity title.

@phoneActHelpTitle.description: Title of the help sheet of the Activity screen.

phoneActHelp1: Every payment you send or receive is listed here, newest first.

@phoneActHelp1.description: First line of the Activity help sheet.

phoneActHelp2: Payments that are not finished yet stay at the top, under In progress.

@phoneActHelp2.description: Second line of the Activity help sheet.

phoneActHelp3: Tap a payment to see where it stands and what you can do with it.

@phoneActHelp3.description: Third line of the Activity help sheet.

@phonePayHelpTitle.description: Title of the help sheet on the payment page.

phonePayHelp1: The steps show where the payment is and why it is there.

@phonePayHelp1.description: First help line on the payment page.

phonePayHelp2: While a payment waits, its coins stay set aside. If it never finishes, you can cancel it.

@phonePayHelp2.description: Second help line on the payment page.

phonePayHelp3: More details has the address, the block and the payment ID.

@phonePayHelp3.description: Third help line on the payment page.

@phonePayTo.description: Line under the amount on the payment page for a payment the user sent.

@phonePayFrom.description: Line under the amount on the payment page for a payment the user received.

@phonePayCompleted.description: Row on the payment page of a finished payment, before its date.

@phonePayCompletedOn.description: Row on the payment page of a finished payment, with its date.

@phonePayNever.description: Gold row and sheet title on the payment page of a payment that waits.

phonePayNeverSend: While a payment waits, its coins stay set aside and nothing is lost. If it never finishes, cancel it and the coins return to your balance.

@phonePayNeverSend.description: Body of the sheet 'What if it never finishes?' for a payment the user sent.

phonePayNeverReceive: Nothing is added to your balance until the payment is confirmed. If it never finishes, you can cancel it here and it is dropped.

@phonePayNeverReceive.description: Body of the sheet 'What if it never finishes?' for a payment the user receives.

@phonePayNote.description: Row label on the payment page for the user's note.

@phonePayAddNote.description: Gold row on the payment page when there is no note yet.

@phonePayLabel.description: Row label on the payment page for the user's label.

@phonePayAddLabel.description: Gold row on the payment page when there is no label yet.

@phonePayFee.description: Row label on the payment page for the fee paid to the network.

@phonePayMore.description: Row on the payment page that opens the details sheet; also its title.

@phonePaySentThrough.description: Row label in the details sheet: how a sent payment travelled.

@phonePayReceivedThrough.description: Row label in the details sheet: how a received payment travelled.

@phonePayTotal.description: Row label in the details sheet: the amount plus the fee.

@phonePayBlock.description: Row label in the details sheet: the block that holds the payment.

@phonePayId.description: Row label in the details sheet: the payment's identifier.

@phonePayCoins.description: Row label in the details sheet: how many coins (outputs) the payment used.

@phonePayOutputsOne.description: Value of the Coins used row when one coin was used.

@phonePayOutputsMany.description: Value of the Coins used row when several coins were used.

@phonePayViaSent.description: Title of the route sheet of a sent payment.

@phonePayViaReceived.description: Title of the route sheet of a received payment.

@phonePayRouteEpicbox.description: Name of the Epicbox route. A product name.

@phonePayRouteEpic1.description: Name of the route of a payment link.

@phonePayRouteInPerson.description: Name of the route where two phones show each other a code.

@phonePayRouteFile.description: Name of the route of a payment file.

@phonePayRouteTor.description: Name of the route straight to the other wallet over Tor.

@phonePayRouteHttp.description: Name of the route straight to the other wallet over a live connection.

phonePayViaEpicboxOutNamed: The payment waited on an Epicbox server until {name}'s wallet collected it. {name} did not need to be online when you sent it.

@phonePayViaEpicboxOutNamed.description: Explanation in the route sheet for a payment sent by Epicbox to a named person.

phonePayViaEpicboxOut: The payment waited on an Epicbox server until the other wallet collected it. They did not need to be online when you sent it.

@phonePayViaEpicboxOut.description: Explanation in the route sheet for a payment sent by Epicbox to someone with no name.

phonePayViaEpicboxIn: The payment waited on an Epicbox server until your wallet collected it. You did not need to be online when it was sent.

@phonePayViaEpicboxIn.description: Explanation in the route sheet for a payment received by Epicbox.

phonePayViaEpic1: The payment was sealed in a link and handed over by you. Whoever opened the link in Epic Wallet received it.

@phonePayViaEpic1.description: Explanation in the route sheet for a payment made with a payment link.

phonePayViaInPerson: The two phones showed each other a code. Nothing waited on a server.

@phonePayViaInPerson.description: Explanation in the route sheet for a payment made in person.

phonePayViaFile: The payment was passed back and forth as a file. Nothing waited on a server.

@phonePayViaFile.description: Explanation in the route sheet for a payment made with files.

phonePayViaTor: The payment went straight to the other wallet over Tor. Both wallets had to be online.

@phonePayViaTor.description: Explanation in the route sheet for a payment sent straight over Tor.

phonePayViaHttp: The payment went straight to the other wallet over a live connection. Both wallets had to be online.

@phonePayViaHttp.description: Explanation in the route sheet for a payment sent straight to the other wallet.

@phonePayViaServer.description: Row label in the route sheet: the Epicbox server the payment used.

phonePayViaOther: Other ways a payment can travel

@phonePayViaOther.description: Group heading in the route sheet above the list of the other routes.

@phonePayRouteSubEpic1.description: One line under the epic1 link route in the route sheet.

phonePayRouteSubInPerson: Two phones showing each other a code

@phonePayRouteSubInPerson.description: One line under the In person route in the route sheet.

phonePayRouteSubFile: A payment file passed back and forth

@phonePayRouteSubFile.description: One line under the File route in the route sheet.

phonePayRouteSubTor: Straight to their wallet, over Tor

@phonePayRouteSubTor.description: One line under the Tor route in the route sheet.

@phoneProgAtTime.description: Payment steps on a contact's page: the clock time of a step done today, after the step word (Sent at 18:12). {time} is the clock.
